import os,sys,time; sys.path.insert(0,'tests/integration'); from headless_audio_lab.process_supervisor import ProcessSupervisor; out={}; f=None
try:
    with ProcessSupervisor() as sup:
        i=sup.start_process('probe',['/bin/sleep','1'],{},'.','/dev/null','/dev/null'); out['pid']=i.pid
        assert i.pid>0, 'pid not positive'
        assert i.pid in sup.get_owned_pids(), 'pid not registered'
        assert os.path.exists('/proc/%d'%i.pid), 'owned child not alive before cleanup'
        try:
            sup.start_process('bad',['/nonexistent/binary-xyz'],{},'.','/dev/null','/dev/null')
            raise SystemExit('bad command did not propagate error')
        except Exception:
            pass
        sup.cleanup(timeout=5.0)
        assert not os.path.exists('/proc/%d'%i.pid), 'owned child survived cleanup'
        assert sup.verify_cleanup()==[], 'verify_cleanup not empty'
finally:
    pass
print('ft-a1 OK')
